slides.title: Entry Cyber Gets 5x Fewer Applicants
slides.subtitle: The competition isn't what you think.

bullets: Dev roles average 200+ applicants per post
Most candidates drop out at the prep stage
The gap is yours - if you show up ready

caption: Everyone assumes cyber is overcrowded. The numbers say otherwise - entry roles attract a fraction of the applicants that dev jobs do. The barrier isn't competition. It's preparation. Start now. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #jobmarket #infosec #cypherjobs
